newsitem.title: NETHERLANDS: PENGUINS FIND EURO FREEZE TOO COLD FOR COMFORT.
newsitem.headline: PENGUINS FIND EURO FREEZE TOO COLD FOR COMFORT.

text.p: Sub-zero temperatures that have brought a taste of the Arctic to the Netherlands have proved too much for penguins at Amsterdam's zoo.
Zoo-keepers have moved many of their 100 birds into a purpose-built, centrally-heated hut as temperatures slumped to minus 15 degrees Celsius (five degrees Fahrenheit).
But not all qualify for special treatment -- breeding adults have to brave the cold and incubate their eggs in the open air.
"Our black-foot penguins are used to the coasts of southern Africa -- it's now much too cold in Europe for them," zoo spokeswoman Miriam Dresme said.
